definitions.en: Microform equipment comprises devices for recording, storing, or reading miniaturized images of documents on film or similar media.
Random access is the ability to retrieve a stored data item directly without reading preceding items in sequence.
Telephone engineering concerns the design and operation of systems that transmit voice and related signals over distance.
A telephone is a device for two-way voice communication between people at different locations.
Telex is a system for exchanging typed messages between teleprinter terminals over a telecommunications network.
Office management is the coordination of administrative staff, procedures, equipment, and records needed to run an office.
Remote sensing obtains information about the Earth's surface from sensors located away from it, such as those on aircraft or satellites.

scopeNotes.en: An advanced system of information gathering to monitor and forecast developments on the surface of the earth and identify an area's natural resources by looking at the world from aircraft, balloons, or satellites and evaluating the data gathered.

definitions.en: Transistors are semiconductor devices used to switch or amplify electrical signals.
The Internet is a global network of interconnected computer networks that exchange data using shared communication protocols.
Mobile phones are portable devices that use cellular networks for voice calls and other wireless communications.
Open source software is software whose source code is available under a licence permitting its use, modification, and redistribution.
Internet universality is the principle that the Internet should respect human rights, remain open and accessible, and support multistakeholder participation.

scopeNotes.en: Advocates for an Internet that is based on human Rights, that is Open and Accessible to all, and nurtured by Multistakeholder participation (ROAM principles).

definitions.en: Allocation of frequencies assigns portions of the radio spectrum to services or users to coordinate transmissions and limit interference.
High definition TV is television that transmits or displays images at a higher resolution than standard-definition television.
Data analysis is the examination and interpretation of data to identify patterns, answer questions, or support decisions.
Analogue computers represent and process quantities as continuously varying physical signals rather than discrete digital values.
Antennas are devices that transmit or receive electromagnetic waves for wireless communication.
Archive automation uses computer systems to manage archival records, descriptions, retrieval, and related workflows.
Library automation uses computer systems to manage library catalogues, circulation, acquisitions, and other services.
Artificial intelligence develops computer systems capable of tasks associated with human intelligence, such as learning or reasoning.

scopeNotes.en: Capability of a device to perform functions normally associated with human intelligence.

definitions.en: Expert systems are programs that apply encoded specialist knowledge and rules to problems in a particular domain.

scopeNotes.en: Computer system based on a data base created by human authorities on a particular subject.

definitions.en: Pattern recognition is the identification and classification of recurring structures or regularities in data.
Robotics concerns the design, control, and use of robots to perform physical tasks.

scopeNotes.en: An area of artificial intelligence applied to the industrial use of robots for performance of repetitive tasks.

definitions.en: Projectors are devices that cast images or moving pictures onto a screen or other surface.
Automatic translation uses computer systems to convert text or speech from one language into another.
Computational linguistics uses computational methods to model, analyse, and process human language.
Magnetic tapes are flexible strips with a magnetic coating used to record sound, video, or computer data.
Satellite broadcasting transmits radio or television signals via satellites to receiving stations or audiences.
TV/radio equipment comprises devices for producing, transmitting, receiving, or displaying television and radio signals.
Cable television delivers television programmes to subscribers through wired distribution networks.
Radio engineering concerns the design and operation of systems that transmit or receive radio-frequency signals.
Television engineering concerns the technologies used to capture, transmit, receive, and display television programmes.
Office automation uses electronic systems to carry out or streamline routine administrative tasks.
Closed circuit television is a video system in which cameras send images to a limited set of monitors or recorders.
Digital computers process data represented as discrete values according to stored instructions.
Film cameras record still or moving images by exposing photographic film to light.
Character recognition converts images of printed or handwritten characters into machine-readable text.
Broadcasting technology comprises the methods and systems used to distribute audio or video programmes to audiences.
Computer applications are uses of computer systems to perform tasks in domains such as administration, science, or communication.

scopeNotes.en: Use more specific term if appropriate.

definitions.en: Computer programming is the design and writing of instructions that make a computer perform specified tasks.
Data processing is the systematic manipulation and computation of data by computer to produce usable results.

scopeNotes.en: Systematic handling, manipulation, and computation of data, always involving the use of computers. Do not confuse with "information processing".

definitions.en: Information technology comprises systems for creating, storing, processing, and distributing digital information.

scopeNotes.en: Includes technology for data base management systems, as well as for information distribution, such as teleprocessing systems, networks of terminals, videotex systems, micrography, etc.

definitions.en: Office services are administrative support activities such as correspondence, typing, filing, and scheduling.
Electronic circuits are connected electrical components arranged to process or control electrical signals.
Integrated circuits combine many electronic components and their connections on a small semiconductor chip.
Reprography is the reproduction of documents using processes such as photocopying and scanning.
Telecommunications is the transmission of information over distance by electronic or electromagnetic means.
Telecommunications applications are practical uses of distance communication systems for services such as voice, data, and video.
Broadcasting equipment comprises devices used to produce, transmit, or receive radio and television broadcasts.
Communication equipment comprises devices used to send, receive, or relay information between locations.
Computer systems combine hardware, software, and associated devices to process and store data.
Computers are programmable electronic devices that process data according to instructions.
Electronic equipment consists of devices that use electronic circuits to control, process, or communicate signals.
Office equipment consists of machines and devices used to perform administrative tasks in workplaces.
Photographic equipment consists of devices and accessories used to capture, process, or display photographs.
Printing equipment consists of machines and devices used to reproduce text or images on physical media.
Telecommunications equipment consists of devices used to transmit, route, or receive signals over distance.
Colour television is television that transmits and displays images with colour information rather than monochrome images.
Encoding is the representation or transformation of information according to a specified code.
Recording equipment consists of devices used to capture and store sound, video, or other signals.
Lasers are devices that emit a concentrated, coherent beam of light through stimulated emission.
Mobile communication is the exchange of information using wireless devices while users or devices change location.
Space communication is the transmission of information between Earth and spacecraft or between objects in space.
Telematics combines telecommunications and information processing to provide remote data services.

scopeNotes.en: Data transfer services via telecommunication systems.

definitions.en: Communication technology comprises the methods and systems used to transmit, receive, and exchange information.
Computer languages are formal languages used to express instructions or descriptions that computers can process.
Computer aided design uses software to create, modify, analyse, or document designs.
Computer aided manufacturing uses computer systems to plan, control, or automate manufacturing processes.
Computer graphics is the creation and manipulation of visual images using computer systems.
Video games are interactive electronic games that present visual output in response to player actions.
Computer networks connect computing devices so they can exchange data and share resources.
Computer interfaces are points or mechanisms through which computer components, systems, or users exchange information.
Computer terminals are devices used to enter information into and display output from a computer system.
Telecommunications networks link communication devices and transmission facilities to exchange information across locations.
Computer output microforms are microfilm or microfiche records generated directly from computer data.
Computer printers produce physical copies of digital text or images on paper or other media.
Computer peripheral equipment comprises external input, output, and storage devices connected to a computer.
Computer storage devices retain digital data for later retrieval by a computer.
Computer software consists of programs and associated instructions that direct a computer's operations.
File organization is the arrangement of stored computer records and files to support access and management.
Multiuser systems allow several people to use the same computing resources through separate sessions or accounts.
Online systems provide access to computer services or data through an active network connection.
Teleconferencing enables people in different locations to take part in the same meeting through audio, video, or related media.

scopeNotes.en: Conducting conferences simultaneously at dispersed locations using video, telephone or related media.

definitions.en: Magnetic discs store data by magnetizing regions of a rotating disk surface.
Optical discs store digital information in patterns read by a laser, as in CDs and DVDs.
Microcomputers are small computers built around a microprocessor, including personal and laptop computers.
Minicomputers are mid-sized computers historically used by multiple users for tasks between those of personal computers and mainframes.
Microprocessors are integrated circuits that execute a computer's instructions as its central processing unit.
Electronic mail is the exchange of digital messages between users through networked mail systems.

scopeNotes.en: Includes message creation, electronic mail and electronic filing.

definitions.en: Data collection is the systematic gathering of observations, measurements, or records for later use or analysis.
Data exchange is the transfer of structured information between people, organizations, or computer systems.
Data formats specify how information is structured and represented for storage, transmission, or processing.
Transnational data flow is the movement of data across national borders through communication or computing systems.
Digitization converts information from an analogue or physical form, such as a paper document, into a digital representation.

scopeNotes.en: Conversion of paper image or any other traditional document support into electronic image.

definitions.en: Data transmission is the sending of information as signals from one device or location to another.
Word processing uses software to create, edit, format, and produce text documents.
Fax is a method or device for transmitting scanned images of documents over a telecommunications connection.
Semiconductors are materials whose electrical conductivity can be controlled for use in electronic devices.
